correctness.rationale: C²/one-dimensional Weisfeiler–Leman equivalence is characterized by identical multisets of complete rooted universal-cover types, using the standard depth-truncation correspondence. A tree component yields finite universal covers and hence its exact unrooted component type and multiplicity. Any unicyclic component universally covers to a unique two-ended tree with a bi-infinite spine decorated periodically by finite rooted trees. Isomorphisms act on the spine by translations/reflections, recovering the primitive dihedral bracelet and only its aggregate repetition count across components. A period p repeated k times contributes k identical multisets; simple-graph cycle size ≥3 forces k≥max(1,ceil(3/p)). Tree and bracelet factors therefore multiply to the formal product. At n≤5 no two unicyclic components exist, while at n=6 the unique ambiguity is C6 versus C3⊔C3. A fresh independent complete atlas graph enumeration with global simultaneous 1-WL refinement gave class counts 1,1,2,4,9,19,45,106 through n=7 (isomorphism counts 1,1,2,4,9,19,46,108); higher stated coefficients rely on included separate programs and formal proof, not this bounded check.
